page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated physical cores with 128 vCPUs, indicating a one-to-one thread-to-core mapping with no hyperthreading. The system is equipped with an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz.

The instance provides 1024.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, requiring reliance on external block storage for data persistence. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps.

From a resource density perspective, the instance offers a high memory-to-CPU ratio, making it qualitatively cost-efficient for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration. Tradeoffs include the complete absence of local storage and zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. This profile is suitable for large-scale databases, in-memory caching, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-bound data processing tasks.
